paragraphs.text: Ramiro Alcázar Peniche participated in Shipment ENS-11-02 on 2011-01-21. Red del Horizonte Azul was linked to Shipment ENS-11-02 on 2011-01-21. Shipment ENS-11-02 occurred at Ensenada on 2011-01-21. A cooperating defendant with prior work on the El Paso side of the border stated that Alcázar, the maritime logistics figure known as El Remo, moved 90 kg of cocaine out of Ensenada by road toward Los Angeles in the tractor-trailer the crews call Tráiler Delta Hondo, after the harbor searches of early January made a sea departure too risky. The defendant learned of the run from a cousin employed at the boatyard the network uses.

Ramiro Alcázar Peniche used DEMO-ACCT-00238 on 2011-01-21. Gonzalo Ferreira Luján led Red del Horizonte Azul from 2010-05-30 until 2014-11-20. The defendant stated that Alcázar paid the driver through the account identified above and that the account was also used to pay the boatyard's monthly fee. The defendant characterized Ferreira as the head of the network and as the person who decided to shift the load from sea to road.

The reporting office assesses the defendant as having secondhand access to this activity through a family member. The source has no known motive to fabricate the details reported here. The reporting office cannot exclude that the quantity was reported to the cousin inaccurately. The reporting office continues to collect on the boatyard and will report separately on its ownership. The defendant added that the driver was paid more than usual for the road run because the route passed two checkpoints that the network does not control, and that the load was delivered without incident according to the cousin.
